entities.summary: Louis Alexandre Henri Joseph Piré (1827–1887) was a Belgian botanist. He held the position of Professor of Botany at the Université libre de Bruxelles. He issued the exsiccata Les Mousses de la Belgique (1870–1871).

entities.summary: Louis Alexandre Henri Joseph Piré (1827–1887) was a Belgian botanist. He held the position of Professor of Botany at the Université libre de Bruxelles. He issued the exsiccata Les Mousses de la Belgique (1870–1871).
